# environment_throneroom_dwarf_highest
# from RiE gfx/portraits/environments/lotr_portrait_environments.txt
environment_throneroom_dwarf_highest = {

	cubemap = "gfx/portraits/environments/frontend_west_01.dds" # <-- swap if needed
	cubemap_intensity = 0.33          # keeps reflections subtle

	lights = {

		#################################################################
		#                       KEY / MAIN LIGHT                        #
		#################################################################
		0 = {
			type = "spot_light"
			affected_by_shadow = yes

			# Very slightly warm white
			color = hsv{ 0.08 0.40 1.30 }
			position = cylindrical{ 220 280  30 }   # radius, height, angle

			look_at_node = { default = camera_torso_look_at }

			radius   = 1000
			falloff  = 12
			outer_cone_angle = 35
			inner_cone_angle = 5
		}

		#################################################################
		#                         FILL LIGHT                            #
		#################################################################
		1 = {
			type = "spot_light"
			affected_by_shadow = no        # fill light usually doesn’t cast

			# Neutral / slightly cool to balance the key
			color = hsv{ 0.60 1 0.60 }
			position = cylindrical{ 220 180 -30 }

			look_at_node = { default = camera_torso_look_at }

			radius   = 1000
			falloff  = 18
			outer_cone_angle = 45
			inner_cone_angle = 0
		}

		#################################################################
		#                         RIM / KICK                            #
		#################################################################
		2 = {
			type = "directional_light"
			affected_by_shadow = yes

			# Cool blue rim to carve the silhouette
			color = hsv{ 0.55 0.20 1.30 }
			position = cylindrical{ 300 200 -150 }

			look_at_node = { default = camera_torso_look_at }
		}
	}

	# Keeps shadow map tight around the bust so it doesn’t waste resolution
	shadow_camera = {
		position = cylindrical{ 220 280 30 }
		look_at_node = { default = camera_torso_look_at }
		fov = 50
		camera_near_far = { 50 600 }
	}
}

				default = camera_torso_look_at
			}

			# For spot lights and point lights
			radius = 1000
			falloff = 10

			# For point lights
			outer_cone_angle = 35
			inner_cone_angle = 0


		}

		#########################################################################
		#							RIGHT RIM LIGHT								#
		#########################################################################
		1 = {

			type = "spot_light"	# Valid types are "spot_light", "point_light", and "directional_light"
			affected_by_shadow = yes

			color = hsv{ 0.05 0.1 1 } # Hue, saturation, value. Increase value for more intense lights

			# For spot lights and directional lights
			look_at = { 0 5 0 }
			look_at_node = {
				default = camera_torso_look_at
			}

			# For spot lights and point lights
			radius = 1000
			falloff = 10

			# For point lights
			outer_cone_angle = 55
			inner_cone_angle = 0
		}

		#########################################################################
		#							LEFT RIM LIGHT								#
		#########################################################################
		2 = {
			type = "directional_light"
			affected_by_shadow = yes

			color = hsv{ 0.07 0.2 2.5 } # Hue, saturation, value. Increase value for more intense lights

			# For spot lights and directional lights
			look_at = { 0 0 0 }

				default = camera_torso_look_at
			}

			# For spot lights and point lights
			radius = 1000
			falloff = 10

			# For point lights

			inner_cone_angle = 0
		}
	}

	shadow_camera = {
